cases.explain: The verb сказать takes an indirect object in the dative case.

cases.sentence: Они выступят против нас и покинут ___.
cases.translation: They will fight against us and leave the country.
cases.explain: The transitive verb покинуть takes a direct object in the accusative.

cases.sentence: Надсмотрщиков поставили, чтобы изнурять их под невольным ___.
cases.translation: Taskmasters were set to afflict them with forced labor.
cases.explain: The preposition под indicating a condition takes the instrumental case.

cases.sentence: Они построили Питом и Рамсес, города для ___ припасов.
cases.translation: They built Pithom and Raamses, cities for the storage of supplies.
cases.explain: The preposition для governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Они пришли в Египет каждый со своей ___.
cases.translation: They came into Egypt, each with his family.
cases.explain: The preposition с in the sense of 'together with' governs the instrumental case.

cases.translation: Watch them on the birth stool.
cases.explain: The preposition на indicating location takes the prepositional case.

cases.sentence: Но повитухи боялись ___ и не исполняли приказ.
cases.translation: But the midwives feared God and did not carry out the order.
cases.explain: The verb бояться (to fear) governs the genitive case.

cases.translation: Throw every boy into the river Nile.
cases.explain: The preposition в indicating direction takes the accusative case.

reading.ru: Прошло время, и к власти в Египте пришел новый царь, который не знал про Иосифа.
reading.question: What was notable about the new king of Egypt?
options: He was a brother of Joseph
reading.explain: The text describes the new king as one 'который не знал про Иосифа' (who did not know Joseph).

reading.ru: Египтяне поставили над израилетянами надсмотрщиков, чтобы изнурять их под невольным трудом, и те построили фараону Питом и Рамсес, города для хранения припасов.
reading.question: What did the Israelites build for Pharaoh?
options: The storage cities Pithom and Raamses
reading.correct: The storage cities Pithom and Raamses
reading.explain: The text says they built 'Питом и Рамсес, города для хранения припасов' (Pithom and Raamses, storage cities).

reading.ru: Царь Египта сказал еврейским повитухам, которых звали Шифра и Пуа.
reading.question: What were the names of the two Hebrew midwives?
reading.explain: The text names the midwives 'Шифра и Пуа' (Shiphrah and Puah).

reading.ru: Но повитухи боялись Бога и не исполняли приказ египетского царя.
reading.question: Why did the midwives not carry out the king's order?
options: Because they were afraid of the mothers
reading.explain: The text says 'повитухи боялись Бога' (the midwives feared God) and did not obey.

reading.ru: За то, что поветухи боялись Бога, он даровал им в награду семьи и детей.
reading.question: What did God give the midwives as a reward?
reading.explain: The text says God gave them 'в награду семьи и детей' (families and children as a reward).

reading.ru: Каждого мальчика, который рождается у евреев, бросайте в реку Нил, а девочек оставляйте в живых.
reading.question: What did Pharaoh command concerning newborn boys?
options: To throw them into the Nile River
To raise them in the palace
reading.correct: To throw them into the Nile River
reading.explain: Pharaoh commands that every boy be thrown 'в реку Нил' (into the river Nile) while girls are kept alive.
